confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors come from a few travel and cost-of-living aggregator pages that partly conflict, so they are rough ballparks. Cocktail and wine anchors are partly inferred from local price bands and the beer anchor. The mid-range two-person anchor is set above one aggregator's $28 figure because that figure looks low for three courses. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no searches run, so they are the least certain. The FX value was taken from search results for RBA table F11.1 and was not read directly from the table; the 2026-10-16 observation may be provisional before the post-4 pm update.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is Bangkok-specific aggregator price data for food and drink, with a general Southeast Asian capital price band for accommodation. Local prices were converted at roughly 33 THB per USD.
